Title: generate sends every generation parameter unchanged including topK and trimmed instructions
PreConditions: apiClient.post mocked to resolve a success envelope
Steps: Call questionsApi.generate with a full GenerateParams object
Expected: POST /api/ai/questions/generate with the params object unchanged

Title: A 429 rate-limit response maps to an ApiError carrying the status and the trace id
PreConditions: apiClient.post mocked to reject with an axios error carrying a response
TestData: status=429; body.message='Quá số lượt cho phép'; body.traceId='tr-429'
Expected: ApiError with the body message, status 429 and traceId 'tr-429'

Title: An aborted request maps to the timeout ApiError when axios reports ECONNABORTED
PreConditions: apiClient.post mocked to reject with an axios error carrying code ECONNABORTED and no response
Expected: ApiError 'Yêu cầu quá thời gian chờ' with no status

Title: The generate button stays disabled until the topic has non-whitespace content then renders one card per question
PreConditions: Instructor session seeded; generate POST resolved
Steps: Render AIQuestionPage; type whitespace then a topic; click Generate
TestData: topic='   ' then 'React hooks'; set with 1 question whose text contains a script tag
Expected: Button disabled while the topic is empty and while it is whitespace only; after Generate the card shows the question text as literal text with no script element, both options, the source title, and a summary reading '1 câu hỏi đã sẵn sàng'; the empty placeholder is gone

Title: A rate-limited generation shows the backend message and withdraws the empty placeholder
PreConditions: Instructor session seeded; generate POST rejected with a 429 ApiError
Steps: Render AIQuestionPage; type a topic; click Generate
Expected: Alert shows 'Quá số lượt cho phép'; the empty placeholder and any question card are absent
